label: Illustrative AI output
callWith: Mother Yesenia Morales (legal guardian), through a Spanish interpreter. Shown in English.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Good evening, is this Mrs. Morales? This is Maria, the nurse with Gulf Coast. A Spanish interpreter is on the line.

transcript.speaker: Mother
transcript.text: Yes. Is this about the bill from the hospital?

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: It's about Valentina's asthma, and there's no copay for her visit. Which inhalers do you have at home?

transcript.speaker: Mother
transcript.text: The blue one and the orange one. I use the orange when she wheezes.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Did you get the nebulizer medicine from the ER?

transcript.speaker: Mother
transcript.text: No. I asked about it on the phone and nobody told me how. I work until late. The nebulizer machine works.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Do you have a spacer for the inhaler?

transcript.speaker: Mother
transcript.text: There's mold in the bathroom and cockroaches. The landlord doesn't answer. My brother smokes inside, but maybe he's stopped, I don't know.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Has she had her flu shot this year?

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Would it be OK to share an asthma plan with the school nurse?

transcript.speaker: Mother
transcript.text: Yes, please. And call after 7:30. I work at the restaurant Thursday to Sunday until 10.

facts.label: Controller use
facts.value: Uses the orange inhaler only when wheezing; the nebulizer medicine from the ED was never picked up
